questions.prompt: Five years ago, Nuri was three times as old as Sonu. Ten years later, Nuri will be twice as old as Sonu. Find their present ages.
questions.modelAnswer: Let Nuri be x and Sonu y. x − 5 = 3(y − 5), so x − 3y = −10. x + 10 = 2(y + 10), so x − 2y = 10. Subtracting: y = 20, then x = 50. Nuri is 50 and Sonu is 20. Check: 45 = 3 × 15 ✓ and 60 = 2 × 30 ✓.
